description: Trim the visible area of each page by the given margins, in points (72 = 1 inch). This sets the CropBox, so the trimmed content is HIDDEN, not removed — it stays in the file and anyone can restore it. Cropping is not redaction. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

bottom.description: Points to trim from the bottom (default: 0)

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists

left.description: Points to trim from the left (default: 0)

output.description: Path to write the cropped PDF

right.description: Points to trim from the right (default: 0)

top.description: Points to trim from the top (default: 0)

name: pdf_crop
title: Crop PDF margins
